args.body: Take BILINGUAL-TECHNICAL-AGENCY-PAID-PILOT under a valid lease. Reuse prior agency findings and prioritize an original brief explicitly inviting suppliers for paid EN/FR technical documentation or localization QA. Use the existing three-capture allowance. Once a brief states a measurable requirement, run a passing and failing fictional control tied to that exact wording. Save the source URL, quotation and hash alongside the command and actual output. Keep the result usable as a private sample if supplier eligibility, AI disclosure rules, submission authority or CAD collection remain unresolved. Prepare a nonbinding operator response only if the original terms support it. If the allowance ends without a qualifying brief, record the sources actually inspected and what original buyer evidence would reopen the route. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. No external contact or deployment.
